text: But surely," said Margaret, facing round, "you believe in what I said, that God gave her life,
translation: 하지만 확실히," 마가렛이 돌아보며 말했습니다. "당신은 하나님께서 그녀에게 생명을 주셨다는 내 말을 믿으세요.

text: and ordered what kind of life it was to be.
translation: 그리고 어떤 삶을 살아야 할지 명령했습니다.

text: I'm sorry, but I can't help you.
I'm afraid I can't help you.
